name: inet-pdfc
description: Compare two PDFs on the i-net PDFC demo server and see what changed.

interface.longDescription: Compare two PDF documents with i-net PDFC and get a clear summary of what changed. i-net PDFC separates content changes (added, removed or replaced text and images) from formatting and layout changes, lists the first differences with their page, and gives you a link to the interactive comparison in your browser. Profiles such as Text with styles or Text only control what counts as a difference. This version uses the public i-net PDFC demo server: the PDFs you attach are uploaded to that server for the comparison, and demo limits apply (up to 20 MB per file, 2 comparisons and 50 pages per session). Using your own i-net PDFC server? Contact i-net software for the desktop integration.
capabilities: Separate content changes from formatting changes
defaultPrompt: Compare these two PDFs and tell me what changed.
Are these two PDF versions identical?
Compare these two PDFs with the Text only profile.

positive.description: Start a new conversation. Changed synthetic invoices: attach Original.pdf and Revised.pdf from the reviewer fixtures. No login is needed; the demo runs anonymously.
positive.prompt: Compare these two invoices with i-net PDFC. Original.pdf is the original and Revised.pdf is the revised version. What changed?
positive.expected_behavior: compare_pdfs receives both files as original and revised (default profile Text with styles). The answer reports 3 content changes on page 1 (due date 06 November to 21 October, unit price 100.00 to 150.00, total 1,000.00 to 1,500.00), no formatting or layout changes, and a link to https://pdfc.demo.inetsoftware.de/comparison/<id>.

positive.description: Start a new conversation (a demo session allows 2 comparisons, so each comparison case runs in its own conversation). Identical files: attach Original.pdf and Identical.pdf, a byte-identical copy.
positive.prompt: Are Original.pdf and Identical.pdf different? Check with i-net PDFC.
positive.expected_behavior: The answer reports no differences (0 content changes, 0 formatting or layout changes) with the profile Text with styles and gives the link to the interactive comparison. It does not claim more than the profile checks.

positive.description: Start a new conversation. Explicit comparison profile: attach Original.pdf and Revised.pdf.
positive.prompt: Compare Original.pdf and Revised.pdf with i-net PDFC using the Text only profile.
positive.expected_behavior: compare_pdfs receives the profile Text only or its ID. The answer names the profile Text only, reports the same 3 content changes and gives a comparison link.

positive.description: Result of an existing comparison without uploading again. Run in the conversation of the first case, after it.
positive.prompt: Show me the result of that first comparison again, without uploading the files.
positive.expected_behavior: get_comparison_result receives the comparison_id returned in the first case. The answer repeats the 3 content changes and the same comparison link. No new comparison is created.

positive.description: Profiles and limits, no files attached.
positive.prompt: Which comparison profiles and limits does i-net PDFC offer?
positive.expected_behavior: The answer lists the profiles Text only, Text with styles, Text with text recognition (OCR), Continuous document, Page by page comparison and Verify identity, names Text with styles as the default, and the demo limits: 20 MB per file, 2 comparisons, 50 pages and 20 MB storage per session. No comparison is created.

negative.description: Only one PDF attached. The plugin compares two documents and must not start a comparison with a single file; it asks for the second PDF. Attach Original.pdf (https://download.inetsoftware.de/Original.pdf).
negative.prompt: Compare this PDF with i-net PDFC.

negative.description: Editing a PDF. The plugin only compares documents and must not be used for this request; ChatGPT may say that i-net PDFC cannot edit PDFs or handle the request with its own capabilities. Attach Revised.pdf (https://download.inetsoftware.de/Revised.pdf).
negative.prompt: Change the total in this invoice PDF to 2,000.00.

negative.description: Merging PDFs. The plugin does not merge documents and must not be used for this request; ChatGPT may handle the request with its own capabilities. Attach Original.pdf (https://download.inetsoftware.de/Original.pdf) and Revised.pdf (https://download.inetsoftware.de/Revised.pdf).
negative.prompt: Merge these two PDFs into one document.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or upgrades inside the plugin. Comparisons run on the free i-net PDFC demo server with its demo limits.

publication.release_notes: First public release: compare two PDFs on the i-net PDFC demo server, with a summary that separates content from formatting changes and a link to the interactive comparison.
